notes: Both Chinese accounts identify 劉振 as the 御史 jailer guarding the deposed crown prince at 許昌; both describe his moving the prince to 小坊 and cutting off food, and his subsequent execution. This is a specific episode bridge, not merely the English name.
zizhitongjian:083:p055: s0206 詔以黃門首辭班示公卿，遣東武公澹以千兵防衛太子，幽於許昌宮，令持書御史劉振持節守之，詔宮臣不得辭送。 s0239 慮以告劉振，振乃徙太子於小坊中，絕其食，宮人猶竊於牆上過食與之。 s0274 誅劉振、董猛、孫慮、程據等；
